gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: EML4-ALK is a fusion-driven GoF target and WT ALK is dispensable in adult tissue, so full inhibition carries little on-target liability.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Alk-null mice are viable with only mild neurobehavioral phenotype; WT ALK expression is restricted to CNS/neural tissue; alectinib and Takeda's brigatinib are approved and well tolerated.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: A mutant-selective G12C agent spares WT KRAS, so the essential normal-tissue role of WT KRAS does not gate on-target safety.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Sotorasib and adagrasib are approved covalent G12C-selective inhibitors well tolerated in patients; the GoF (germline KRAS activation causes Noonan) mutant-selective mechanism downgrades the WT-constraint concern.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: CD30 expression is confined to activated lymphocytes and Reed-Sternberg cells with negligible essential normal-tissue role, giving a clean safety window for an ADC.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Brentuximab vedotin (Adcetris, marketed ex-US by Takeda) is an approved CD30 ADC with a manageable on-target profile; restricted antigen expression is the canonical anchor.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: BCMA is plasma-cell restricted and its on-target effect is a tolerated plasma-cell aplasia, not loss of an essential gene.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved BCMA T-cell engagers teclistamab and elranatamab show on-target plasma-cell depletion / hypogammaglobulinemia that is managed with Ig replacement; no broad essential-tissue expression.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: CD20 is a B-lineage-restricted antigen absent from stem cells and plasma cells, so on-target B-cell aplasia is reversible and well tolerated.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Two decades of rituximab use establish a benign on-target safety precedent; CD20 is not expressed on hematopoietic progenitors, preserving recovery.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: POLR2A encodes the RNA Pol II catalytic subunit, a universally essential housekeeping gene with no therapeutic window for full inhibition.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: DepMap common-essential across all lineages; gnomAD LOEUF near 0 (extreme LoF intolerance); full loss is cell-lethal in every proliferating tissue.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: CDK1 is the non-redundant master mitotic kinase; complete inhibition arrests all dividing normal tissue, precluding an on-target safety window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: DepMap pan-/common-essential dependency; no viable full-KO in dividing cells; historical mitotic-inhibitor programs limited by broad hematologic/GI toxicity.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: Platelet survival depends on BCL-XL, so full inhibition produces dose-limiting on-target thrombocytopenia.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Navitoclax dose-limiting thrombocytopenia is a documented clinical on-target tox precedent; it directly motivated the platelet-sparing PROTAC degrader DT2216, confirming the liability.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: MDM2 is an essential p53 regulator and its inhibition produces on-target dose-limiting myelosuppression.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Mdm2-KO is embryonic lethal (rescued only by concurrent p53 loss); MDM2 inhibitors (idasanutlin, milademetan) show dose-limiting thrombocytopenia and neutropenia in trials.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: PLK1 is an essential mitotic kinase whose full inhibition causes on-target myelosuppression in proliferating hematopoietic tissue.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: DepMap common-essential dependency + documented dose-limiting on-target neutropenia in the clinic (volasertib, BI 2536).

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: Transferrin receptor is ubiquitously expressed and essential for iron uptake, so targeting it broadly damages normal (especially erythroid) tissue.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Ubiquitous normal expression atlas (incl. erythroid progenitors) + DepMap pan-essential dependency; on-target anemia is the expected liability.

review_queue.label: negative
review_queue.rationale: Aurora A is an essential mitotic kinase and its full inhibition drives on-target hematologic toxicity, narrowing the therapeutic window.
review_queue.evidence_basis: Takeda's alisertib (MLN8237) had dose-limiting neutropenia as its principal on-target toxicity; AURKA is a common mitotic-essential dependency.

review_queue.label: negative
review_queue.rationale: MYC is required by rapidly regenerating normal tissues (intestinal crypt, bone marrow), so complete degradation would produce broad on-target toxicity.
review_queue.evidence_basis: DepMap common-essential dependency + essential role in normal proliferating compartments (gut/hematopoietic); systemic pan-MYC inhibition tolerability is a known liability.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: EML4-ALK fusion is the defining oncogenic driver of ALK+ NSCLC, an addiction validated by dramatic responses to ALK TKIs.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved ALK TKIs (crizotinib, alectinib, brigatinib, lorlatinib) with fusion-selected benefit; EML4-ALK is a bona fide driver rearrangement.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: BCMA is a validated plasma-cell/B-cell-maturation lineage antigen in myeloma, a strong therapeutic link even though it is not a cell-intrinsic fitness dependency.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved BCMAxCD3 T-cell engager teclistamab (plus belantamab ADC and ide-cel/cilta-cel CAR-T) — a validated immunotherapy antigen.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: CD30 is a lineage-defining antigen on Reed-Sternberg and ALCL cells, an established therapeutic target link.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved CD30-directed ADC brentuximab vedotin in classical Hodgkin lymphoma and sALCL (a Takeda-marketed antigen program).

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: Androgen-receptor signaling is the lineage-defining oncogenic driver of prostate cancer, sustained even in castration-resistant disease.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved AR-pathway agents (enzalutamide, abiraterone) plus clinical-stage AR degraders (bavdegalutamide/ARV-110) — a canonical driver and degrader target.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: CD20 is a B-cell lineage antigen and the backbone antigen of B-cell NHL therapy, an uncontested therapeutic link.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved anti-CD20 antibody rituximab (R-CHOP standard of care) — a validated lineage antigen, not a fitness dependency.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: The IGF1R-in-NSCLC hypothesis failed to replicate clinically, undermining the target-disease link.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Figitumumab Phase III program terminated for futility/harm; no biomarker-defined IGF1R-driven NSCLC subtype emerged.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: Titin's recurrent mutations are length-biased passengers with no oncogenic driver role in CRC.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Largest human gene; excluded by driver-detection consensus (MutSigCV/IntOGen) as a background-frequency passenger — not a driver or dependency.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: The stromal Hedgehog rationale for SMO in PDAC failed to replicate clinically despite strong preclinical premise.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Vismodegib and saridegib (IPI-926) added to chemo showed no benefit / potential harm in PDAC trials; SMO is validated only in basal cell carcinoma.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: Breast cancer is not a RAS-driven lineage; KRAS mutation is rare and non-driving, so no established target-disease link exists in this indication.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: KRAS mutation frequency ~1-2% in breast with no recognized KRAS-mutant driver subtype (contrast CRC/NSCLC/PDAC where KRAS is a driver).

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: CD19 is a B-lymphocyte-restricted antigen with no expression or biological link in SCLC, a neuroendocrine epithelial tumor.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: CD19 validated only in B-cell malignancies (blinatumomab, CAR-T); absent from SCLC lineage — a wrong-lineage antigen with no disease link.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: KRAS is the most recurrent oncogenic driver in CRC (~40%) and confers a selective genetic dependency in KRAS-mutant lines.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: DepMap CRISPR selective dependency in KRAS-mutant lines + recurrent driver; G12C inhibitors sotorasib/adagrasib approved (CRC via EGFR combos).

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: BTK-driven B-cell receptor signaling is the established oncogenic pathway in MCL, an experimentally and clinically validated dependency.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved covalent BTK inhibitors (ibrutinib/acalabrutinib/zanubrutinib) + clinically active BTK degraders (NX-5948, BGB-16673) confirm target-disease link.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: CD19 is a pan-B-lineage antigen expressed on essentially all B-ALL blasts — a canonical immunotherapy antigen (not a cell-intrinsic dependency).
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Validated antigen: blinatumomab (CD19xCD3), CD19 CAR-T (tisa-cel), tafasitamab all approved in B-cell malignancies.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: The MMP-in-cancer rationale failed to translate; MMP9 is a stromal-remodeling bystander whose inhibition gave no clinical benefit in gastric cancer.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Clinical failure: anti-MMP9 andecaliximab missed OS in the Phase 3 GAMMA-1 trial (HER2-negative gastric/GEJ).

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: gp100/PMEL is a melanocyte-lineage differentiation antigen absent from colorectal epithelium, so there is no target-disease link in CRC.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Expression-atlas lineage restriction: PMEL is the melanocytic tebentafusp target (uveal melanoma); not expressed in colorectal adenocarcinoma.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: Folate receptor-alpha is tumor-restricted with limited/apically-buried normal epithelial expression, giving a validated ADC window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Mirvetuximab soravtansine (Elahere) FDA-approved 2022 for FRalpha-positive platinum-resistant ovarian cancer; normal expression confined to apical epithelial surfaces (kidney/lung) largely inaccessible to IV antibody.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: DLL3 is near-absent from normal adult tissue yet highly surface-expressed on neuroendocrine/SCLC cells, an essentially ideal tumor-selective window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Tarlatamab (Imdelltra) DLL3xCD3 T-cell engager FDA-approved 2024 for ES-SCLC; DLL3 normal expression is minimal (Notch ligand internalized in normal cells), high on neuroendocrine tumors.

gold_upheld.indication: Hodgkin lymphoma / CD30+ anaplastic large-cell lymphoma
gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: CD30 (TNFRSF8) is restricted to activated lymphocytes and Reed-Sternberg/ALCL cells, sparing most normal tissue and giving a clean ADC window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Brentuximab vedotin (Adcetris, Takeda) FDA-approved for classical Hodgkin lymphoma and systemic ALCL; CD30 normal expression limited to a small subset of activated B/T lymphocytes.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: The CLDN18.2 isoform's normal epitope is buried in gastric-mucosa tight junctions but exposed on tumor cells, yielding a defensible tumor-selective window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Zolbetuximab (Vyloy) anti-CLDN18.2 mAb FDA-approved 2024 for CLDN18.2-positive HER2-negative gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma; normal CLDN18.2 restricted to differentiated gastric mucosa with epitope masked by tight junctions.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: Amplification-driven HER2 overexpression on tumor cells vs low normal-epithelial levels underpins a validated, widely-approved surface-antigen window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Trastuzumab and trastuzumab deruxtecan (Enhertu) approved for HER2-positive gastric and breast cancer; tumor selectivity is amplification/overexpression-driven (companion IHC/ISH biomarker), with only manageable on-target cardiac expression.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: Transferrin receptor (CD71) is ubiquitously expressed and essential for iron uptake in all proliferating and erythroid cells, leaving no tumor-vs-normal window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: TFRC is required for erythropoiesis and broadly expressed across normal proliferating tissues; no selective surface window for a naked/ADC/TCE approach.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: CD47 is a ubiquitous 'don't-eat-me' signal expressed on erythrocytes and normal cells, creating a massive antigen sink and on-target anemia.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Magrolimab (anti-CD47) causes on-target anemia from erythrocyte CD47 binding; broad normal expression drove RBC sink and dosing/tolerability problems, with programs halted.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: EpCAM is expressed across essentially all normal epithelia, so a T-cell engager or potent ADC has a poor therapeutic window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Catumaxomab (EpCAMxCD3 trifunctional) was withdrawn from market amid hepatic/GI toxicity; EpCAM basolateral expression is pan-epithelial (liver, GI, etc.).

gold_upheld.indication: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: CD44 (incl. v6 isoform) is expressed on normal keratinocytes and broadly across epithelial/hematopoietic tissue, producing fatal-grade on-target skin toxicity.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Bivatuzumab mertansine (anti-CD44v6 ADC) caused fatal skin toxicity from normal keratinocyte CD44v6 expression; the clinical program was terminated.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: Claudin-18.2 is normally buried in gastric-mucosa tight junctions (epitope inaccessible) but becomes surface-exposed on tumor cells, yielding a favorable selective window despite gastric lineage origin.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Normal-tissue expression restricted to differentiated gastric mucosa with sequestered epitope; clinical precedent = zolbetuximab (anti-CLDN18.2 mAb, Vyloy) approved 2024 for CLDN18.2+/HER2- gastric/GEJ.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: BCMA is expressed almost exclusively on plasma cells/plasmablasts; the only on-target normal compartment is B-lineage, so depletion produces manageable hypogammaglobulinemia rather than critical-organ toxicity.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Lineage-restricted plasma-cell expression (no vital-organ expression); multiple approved agents (teclistamab BCMAxCD3 TCE 2022, belantamab ADC, ide-cel/cilta-cel CAR-T) validate the selective window.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: IGF1R is broadly expressed across normal tissues and drives systemic metabolic signaling, so antibody blockade produces on-target hyperglycemia/metabolic toxicity with no selective tumor window.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Ubiquitous normal expression + metabolic axis role; clinical precedent = failure of figitumumab/cixutumumab/dalotuzumab (broad Ph3 failures with hyperglycemia) despite occasional Ewing responses.

review_queue.label: negative
review_queue.rationale: Wild-type EGFR is broadly expressed on normal skin and GI epithelium, so a cytotoxic/engager surface payload has a narrow, tox-limited window.
review_queue.evidence_basis: Cetuximab's dose-limiting acneiform rash / GI toxicity reflects normal keratinocyte and gut-epithelial EGFR; EGFR ADCs (e.g. depatuxizumab mafodotin) constrained by normal-tissue expression.

review_queue.label: negative
review_queue.rationale: CEA is highly expressed on the luminal surface of normal colonic and GI epithelium, narrowing the tumor-vs-normal window and contributing to on-target/off-tumor liability.
review_queue.evidence_basis: High normal GI-epithelial CEACAM5; clinical precedent = tusamitamab ravtansine Phase III CARMEN-LC03 failure (2023), reflecting insufficient selective window.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: ALK-fusion NSCLC is drugged by multiple approved small-molecule TKIs, so there is an unambiguously viable modality.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved drugs crizotinib, alectinib, lorlatinib, and brigatinib (Takeda) targeting the EML4-ALK fusion kinase.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: EGFR-mutant NSCLC has a deep bench of approved TKIs spanning classical and exon20 mutations, confirming clear small-molecule tractability.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved osimertinib (classical activating mutations) and mobocertinib (Takeda, exon20 insertions) directly inhibiting mutant EGFR kinase.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: CD30 is a validated internalizing surface antigen with an approved ADC, so an antibody-based modality is clearly viable.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved ADC brentuximab vedotin (Adcetris, Takeda/Seagen) targeting CD30 in classical Hodgkin lymphoma and systemic ALCL.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: BCMA is a clinically validated myeloma surface antigen addressable by multiple biologic formats including approved T-cell engagers.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved BCMAxCD3 bispecific teclistamab (plus belantamab ADC and BCMA CAR-T) in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: CD20 is the archetypal drugged B-cell surface antigen with decades of approved naked and engineered antibodies.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved anti-CD20 antibodies (rituximab, obinutuzumab) foundational to NHL therapy.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: The estrogen receptor is drugged and degraded clinically, giving a validated degrader modality precedent.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Approved selective estrogen receptor degrader fulvestrant (and oral SERD elacestrant) that trigger ER degradation.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: MYC is the canonical undruggable transcription factor with no ligandable pocket and no approved direct agent despite decades of effort.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Intrinsically disordered bHLH-LZ oncoprotein; Pharos non-Tclin, zero approved direct small-molecule or biologic inhibitors.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: Beta-catenin is a scaffold/transcriptional effector with no druggable active site and no approved direct inhibitor.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: No approved agent directly inhibiting beta-catenin; WNT-pathway direct targeting remains preclinical/failed.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: STK11/LKB1 is a loss-of-function tumor suppressor that cannot be pharmacologically restored, so there is no direct modality.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Germline LoF causes Peutz-Jeghers; somatic inactivating/deletion events are not addressable by inhibition or degradation.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: TP53 is an inactivated tumor suppressor whose direct pharmacological reactivation has repeatedly failed in the clinic.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Li-Fraumeni germline LoF; mutant-p53 reactivator eprenetapopt (APR-246) failed its Phase 3 MDS endpoint.

gold_upheld.label: negative
gold_upheld.rationale: MYCN is an amplification-driven transcription factor with no ligandable pocket and no approved direct inhibitor.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Undruggable bHLH-LZ TF; no approved direct agent, programs limited to indirect (e.g. BET/Aurora) approaches.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: HER2 is an amplification-driven cell-surface RTK with approved antibody and ADC agents in gastric cancer.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Trastuzumab approved via ToGA and T-DXd approved in HER2+ gastric; validated surface antigen with amplification-linked dependency.

gold_upheld.label: positive
gold_upheld.rationale: IKZF3 (Aiolos) is degradable via approved CRBN molecular glues, giving a proven degrader modality for an otherwise TF-like target.
gold_upheld.evidence_basis: Lenalidomide/pomalidomide are approved CRBN molecular-glue degraders of IKZF1/IKZF3 in myeloma; degradation is the validated mechanism of IMiD efficacy.

review_queue.label: negative
review_queue.rationale: STAT3 is a hard transcription factor with a shallow SH2 pocket and no approved direct inhibitor after repeated failures.
review_queue.evidence_basis: Pharos Tchem at best for direct inhibition; multiple failed direct small-molecule/SH2 programs; only indirect (antisense/upstream JAK) approaches advanced.

critique:
## Coverage + balance critique of the per-dimension gold seed

### Positive/negative balance (upheld only)

| dimension | positive→LOW | negative→HIGH | read |
|---|---|---|---|
| safety | 5 | 6 | balanced |
| biological | 8 | 7 | balanced (the healthy template) |
| selectivity | 7 | 5 | positive-tilted (+ 1 duplicate, see below) |
| druggability | 8 | 5 | positive-tilted |

Raw counts (11–15) are even across dimensions, so the problem is **not thinness — it's diversity and tilt**. Two dimensions lean positive; the real weakness is redundancy inside the positive arm.

### Most decision-relevant gaps

**1. "Hero-target" over-representation collapses effective coverage.** TNFRSF8 (CD30) and TNFRSF17 (BCMA) appear in **all four** dimensions; ALK, MS4A1, ERBB2, IGF1R each recur 2–3×. A roll-up model can score well by memorizing "these ~5 surface antigens / ALK = LOW" without generalizing. This is exactly the overfit-to-motivating-examples failure mode. Cap any single target at ~2 dimensions and backfill with distinct targets.

**2. Selectivity has a literal duplicate and misses the current ADC canon.** `CLDN18/gastric (CLDN18.2+)` and `CLDN18.2/Gastric` are the **same target** counted twice — inflates n and the positive tilt. Missing canonical selective positives that any selectivity gold set should include:
- **TACSTD2/TROP2** (Trodelvy, Dato-DXd) — the biggest omission
- **FOLH1/PSMA** (prostate) — canonical high-selectivity
- **MSLN** (mesothelioma/ovarian/PDAC), **CEACAM5** (NSCLC)
And a canonical selectivity **negative**: **wild-type EGFR** (skin/GI on-target/off-tumor tox) — currently EGFR only appears as a druggability positive.

**3. Druggability is missing the flagship "undruggable→druggable" flips and tilts positive.** KRAS appears in biological and safety but **not druggability** — omitting **KRAS G12C→LOW** (sotorasib/adagrasib) leaves out the single most important recent druggability data point. Also add **BCL2→LOW** (venetoclax) as a PPI-druggable positive. Negatives are strong (MYC, CTNNB1, TP53, MYCN, STK11) — keep those; add positives to correct tilt.

**4. Safety negatives are ALL pan-essential proliferation genes (POLR2A, CDK1, PLK1, BCL2L1, MDM2, TFRC).** The gold set never exercises the **human-genetics/germline-constraint leg** that is the actual signature of the on-target-safety-liability skill (gnomAD LoF constraint, dosage sensitivity, mouse-KO lethality). Add a germline-constrained / mouse-KO-lethal HIGH that is *not* a proliferation gene. Also add **CD19→LOW** as the canonical "on-target/off-tumor tox is tolerated" (B-cell aplasia) safety positive.

**5. Biological is the balance target.** It is the only dimension with 0 review queue, near-even balance, a true passenger control (**TTN/CRC→HIGH**), and lineage-mismatch negatives (CD19/SCLC, PMEL/CRC). Bring the other three up to this standard rather than adding raw volume.

### Label checks
- **CLDN18 vs CLDN18.2 (selectivity):** dedupe — same antigen.
- **STK11, TP53 druggability→HIGH:** defensible only as "not *directly* druggable" (they're LoF TSGs drugged via SL partners); keep, but the gold set has no TSG-that-*is*-druggable-via-glue counterpoint beyond IKZF3.
- **TFRC** as both safety-HIGH and selectivity-HIGH: internally consistent (broadly expressed) but is one of the recurring redundant targets in #1.
- **KRAS/Breast→HIGH (biological)** and **MDM2/TP53-WT→HIGH (safety)**: both correct.

### Priority additions (specific)
- Druggability: **KRAS G12C/NSCLC→LOW**, **BCL2/CLL→LOW**
- Selectivity: **TACSTD2 (TROP2)/breast (TNBC)→LOW**, **FOLH1 (PSMA)/prostate→LOW**, **EGFR-WT/colorectal→HIGH** (skin/GI tox)
- Safety: **CD19/B-ALL→LOW** (tolerated on-target tox), one germline-constrained/mouse-KO-lethal non-proliferation **→HIGH**
- Biological: a fusion-driver positive (**BCR-ABL/CML** or EML4-ALK) to complement the SNV/lineage examples
